verification.command: initial current-truth and Phase 5 plan review
verification.summary: Confirmed the synchronous legacy path, reusable canonical Resolver/Profile and stat_snapshot_v1 boundaries, and the absence of any async snapshot store, worker, endpoint or frontend polling path.

Authority, signature, transaction, concurrency, fencing, recovery, backpressure, privacy, compatibility, performance, deployment and rollback boundaries are explicit with no unresolved product decision.

risks.detail: Signature includes server profile hash and the explicit revision vector; client-supplied signatures are never trusted.
Partial unique single-flight, SKIP LOCKED claim and lock-token fencing are mandatory before activation.
Migration is additive and tables remain dormant in 5A; normal rollback is code/config, not destructive schema removal.
Route, worker, frontend cutover and Phase 6 Catalyst are explicitly excluded from Slice 5A.

summary: Phase 5A is implementation-allowed as a dormant pure signature plus additive PostgreSQL snapshot/job repository slice. No route, worker, frontend behavior or Catalyst capability is active.
